sentences.text: This is the ninth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No.197 of 2019 registered at Police Station - Mahila Thana Padav, District Gwalior (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 376, 376 (2) (n), 370-A, 372, 373, 506 and 34 of IPC and Sections 3, 4, 5(l), 6, 16 and 17 of POCSO Act.

Eighth application of the applicant was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 19.7.2023 passed in MCRC No. 26281 of 2023 with liberty to repeat the prayer for bail after recording of statement of the prosecutrix.
Allegation against the present applicant is that she being the mother of the prosecutrix allowed co-accused Sanju to sexually assault the prosecutrix to gain money.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

Prosecutrix has already been examined as PW- 1, however, she has not supported the Malti Dubey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143654825/
1 case of the prosecution in respect to present applicant - accused and denied the allegations against her in her cross- examination.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Under these circumstances, as the prosecutrix has already been examined, therefore, the question of influencing her does not arise.
Further argument is that the applicant is aged about 60 years and is in custody since 15.8.2020 i.e. since three years.
She has no criminal antecedents and is the permanent resident of District Datia (M.P.) and there is no possibility of her absconsion or tampering with the prosecution evidence.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
Per contra, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, but without expressing any opinion on merits of the case, this application is allowed and it is directed that the applicant be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court/committal Court.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.

(SUNITA YADAV) JUDGE AKS Malti Dubey vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143654825/
